sentences.text: Gattu Anjaiah,And 4 vs State Of ... on 12 August, 2024

The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.30115 of 2015
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioners, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of the respondents in not extending the benefits to the petitioners contemplated under the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy vide G.O.Ms.No.68, dated 08.04.2015 issued by Irrigation and CAD (Project Wing-LA-IV-R&R) Department in lieu of the acquisition of the properties of the petitioners for Mid-Manair reservoir by issuing a Notification in the Karimnagar District Gazette vide Gazette No.64, dated 29.12.2009 as arbitrary, illegal, unlawful,
wholly unsustainable in law and violative of Articles 14, 19, 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and to consequently direct the respondents to grant benefits to the petitioners, as stated in the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy vide G.O.Ms.No.68, dated 08.04.2005 issued by Irrigation and CAD (Project Wing-LA- IV-R&R) Department for the Project Displaced Families in the interest of justice and pass..."

2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
The case of the petitioners is that they are the marginal farmers and they hail from below poverty line, residing at Kodurpaka Village, Boinpally Mandal, Karimnagar District.
Their lands and houses were acquired for the purpose of construction of Mid Manair Reservoir under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

After conducting socio-economic Survey, the respondents have enunciated a scheme vide G.O.Ms.No.68, Irrigation and CAD (Project Wing-LA- IV-R&R) Department, dated 08.04.2005 for extending rehabilitation and resettlement policy.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that the respondents have considered the cases of some of the villagers/marginal farmers, whose lands have been submerged in the Mid Manair Reservoir for paying the compensation amount in terms of the said G.O.

However,
rehabilitation compensation was not paid to the petitioners.

Learned counsel further submitted that,
similarly situated persons have filed writ petitions on the file of this Court vide W.P.No.34439 of 2012 and W.P.No.10658 of 2014 and batch therein, this Court has disposed of the said cases directing the respondents therein to extend the benefit in terms of the said G.O. to all the petitioners therein, whose lands have been submerged for the purpose of construction of Mid Manair Reservoir.
5. Learned Government Pleader appearing for the respondents did not dispute the fact that the petitioners are the marginal farmers and their lands and houses were acquired for the purpose of Gattu Anjaiah,And 4 vs State Of ... on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71100079/
1 construction of Mid Manair Reservoir.
He submitted that the petitioners are not residing in the village three (3) years prior to the issuance of said proceedings.
Therefore, they are not entitled for the rehabilitation compensation in terms of G.O.Ms.No.68, dated 08.04.2005.

6. The procedure adopted by the respondents in not extending to the petitioners the benefits extended to the similarly situated persons amounts to discrimination and is not in consonance with Article 14 of the Constitution of India.

7. Keeping in view the principles laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in various cases that same benefit should be extended to similarly situated persons and following the orders passed by this Court in W.P.No.34439 of 2012, dated 31.01.2013 and W.P.No.10658 of 2014 and batch, dated 17.10.2014, this Writ Petition is allowed.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
___________________________ C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 12.08.2024 vsu Gattu Anjaiah,And 4 vs State Of ... on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71100079/
